intro.label: Welcome
intro.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to the White Cube Mini Golf Open, twenty twenty-six! The putters are polished, the plinths are in position... and the tension is absolutely palpable.

report_in.label: Over to the scores
report_in.text: Right then. Let's have a look at how it all unfolded.

ace.label: Hole in one!
ace.text: It's in! A hole in one! Unbelievable scenes here at the White Cube Open!

new_leader.label: New leader
new_leader.text: And we have a new leader at the top of the board!

spoon.label: Wooden spoon
spoon.text: And spare a thought for our wooden spoon winners. It's the taking part that counts. Apparently.

outro.label: That's the round
outro.text: And that's the round! What a day on the greens. From all of us here at the White Cube Mini Golf Open... goodnight, and mind the plinths.

r_lipout.label: Lip-out
r_lipout.text: Ohhh, a cruel lip-out. They'll be thinking about that one all evening.

r_pressure.label: Pressure putt
r_pressure.text: Pressure putt... for the lead... and it drops!

r_magnificent.label: Magnificent
r_magnificent.text: Absolutely magnificent. Put that one in the permanent collection.

n_intro.label: Nature: intro
n_intro.text: Here, on the manicured savannah of the mini golf course, the White Cube herd gathers. Putters in hand. Each one... quietly hoping to survive the windmill.

n_outro.label: Nature: outro
n_outro.text: And as the light fades over the final green, the herd returns, at last, to the gallery. Nature... is extraordinary.
